desc:
🏠 Tiny thieves. Big trouble. GET OUT!
Sneak into the house with your team and steal everything you can carry… or become the homeowner and send those little thieves packing!

💰 THIEVES: Grab valuables, smash windows, and haul your loot back to the van. Reach your quota and escape before the police arrive!

🔒 HOMEOWNER: Defend your home, knock out intruders, and lock them in cages. Catch every thief to win!

⚡ Unlock unique classes with powerful abilities.

🎃 Collect Candy and explore the Halloween Shop.

🪤 Pick your favorite cage and defend your house in style!

🚓 Heavy loot slows you down, so choose carefully—and never leave a teammate behind!
